name: Temporary Residence by Family Reunification

requirement_groups.name: Spouse, parent, or child of an Argentine citizen

requirements.blocker_text: Sponsor must be a native, naturalized, or by-option Argentine citizen. Authorization lasts up to 3 years maximum.

requirement_groups.name: Spouse, minor child, or disabled adult child of a temporary/permanent resident

requirements.blocker_text: Sponsor must be a temporary or permanent resident; qualifying dependents are spouse, unmarried child under 18 (not emancipated), or an adult child with disabilities. Residence is granted for the same period as the sponsor's own status.

evidence_required.document: Legalized birth or marriage certificate proving the family tie
Sponsor's proof of citizenship or residence status

outcome.duration_length: Matches sponsor's residence period; up to 3 years if sponsor is an Argentine citizen or permanent resident

sources.title: Dirección Nacional de Migraciones -- Obtener una residencia temporaria por reunificación familiar: qualifying relationships for citizen-sponsor and resident-sponsor tracks, up to 3-year duration when sponsor is a citizen

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Argentina). pr_after_months and citizenship_after_months (24) both reflect Ley 346's standalone 2-year continuous-legal-residence naturalization bar, which applies regardless of family sponsorship -- Argentina does not appear to have a distinct, faster marriage-to-citizen naturalization track the way several other countries in this dataset do; the spouse of an Argentine gets easier RESIDENCE (this file) but the same 2-year CITIZENSHIP clock as any other legal resident (see ar_naturalisation.json). A separate, faster non-MERCOSUR-specific family reunification service page exists (argentina.gob.ar/servicio/obtener-una-residencia-temporaria-por-reunificacion-familiar-no-mercosur) but was not independently fetched in this pass -- flagged as a gap since it may carry different documentation specifics for non-MERCOSUR sponsors/applicants.
